mentions.name: Billing Inbox Accounting Automation Tool
mentions.description: An accounting automation tool that captures and extracts information from billing inboxes and sends it to the user's accounting system, saving manual data entry for freelancers and small businesses.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building an accounting automation tool that captures and extracts information received from your billing inboxes and send them to your accounting system.
